name: Review Ask
office_task: After each finished job, line up the same Google review message for every customer, one reminder then stop, hold jobs with an open callback or dispute, and a person releases each batch.
systems_of_record: the job system that issues the job_id and holds its status, callbacks, invoice dispute and complaint (ServiceM8, Simpro, Fergus, Jobber or AroFlo)
the SMS or email account the business owns (the ask, the reminder and the reply, by message_id)
the review record and the exception desk the business runs (a sheet or a list that issues the exception_id)

emits.write: each ask and reminder a named person released, filed against its job in the review record: the job_id, the customer, the channel, the exact body, the message_id and who released it; each reply filed against the job it answers, word for word
emits.readback: the SMS or email account returns a message_id for the send, and reading the review record back by job_id returns that message_id with the body and the releaser; no message_id back means nothing was sent, and a send_failed exception is raised

emits.write: an exception on the job naming the owner: held for an open callback, a disputed invoice or an open complaint; no mobile and no email on record; a send that did not return an id; or a written message that offers something or names stars
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the job_id, the reason and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops
